analysis.session_summary: Overnight the dollar was the weakest major: DXY lost 20.9 points (-0.205%) and USD strength was -0.306%, while NZD (+0.609% vs majors) and AUD (+0.288%) led. Most legs had no clear catalyst; the only scored central-bank events were muted (Bailey +0.001% GBP basket, Macklem -0.021% CAD basket) and Warsh was unscored though briefly bid USD 0.051%. EUR/USD closed 22.1 pips higher at 1.1229 with USD weakness the main contribution (+0.306% vs -0.108% from EUR). The tape reads as a flow-driven USD unwind rather than a fundamental repricing.
